rules.name: grasa-orphan-deals-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT substr(c.contract_number, 1, 3) AS client, c.product_code, c.deal_status, COUNT(*) AS cache_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.security_id IS NULL) AS rows_no_security, COUNT(DISTINCT c.security_id) FILTER (WHERE s.security_id IS NULL) AS distinct_missing_securities FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.security_id = c.security_id AND s.business_unit = c.business_unit WHERE upper(c.business_unit) = :bu GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.security_id IS NULL) > 0 ORDER BY rows_no_security DESC

SELECT substr(c.contract_number, 1, 3) AS client, c.product_code, c.deal_status, COUNT(*) AS cache_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.security_id IS NULL) AS rows_no_security FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.security_id = c.security_id AND s.business_unit = c.business_unit WHERE upper(c.business_unit) = :bu GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.security_id IS NULL) > 0 ORDER BY rows_no_security DESC
